segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Megan at Northstar Packaging. We need to add 8 user seats to our account before our warehouse team training on May 14.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can help with that. I’m pulling up the account in the billing tool now. Can you confirm the workspace name or account number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure, workspace is Northstar Ops, and I think the account number is 48291.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it, I see Northstar Ops on the Standard annual plan with 42 active seats today. You’re adding 8 seats, so that would bring you to 50 total.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: The prorated charge for the 8 additional seats through your renewal date of November 30 is $1,248. It’ll be billed to the card ending in 6114 unless you want a different payment method.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that card is fine. Can you also email the receipt to ap@northstarpackaging.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep. I’ve added the 8 seats and sent the receipt to that AP address. You should also see the new seat count in the admin console in about a minute.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to invite the users one by one?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You can, but for 8 people I’d use the CSV invite option under Admin, Users, Invite users. The knowledge base template is linked right there in the panel.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, yeah, I see it now. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll close ticket 736284 with the seat increase confirmed.
